contracts.guards: Exact member episode and affected assignment generation required from authoritative source proof. Guard keeps compact eligible administrator contributions; every removal withdraws availability before source mutation; a first administrators-team assignment registers availability only through TenantManagerRestorationAccepted (register_administrators_assignment) completed after TeamMemberAssigned. Restoration source writes wait behind unfinished withdrawal and only exact current eligibility can restore guard availability. Bootstrap/reconcile eligible contribution set through authoritative source cut while admission fenced; no directory boolean proves another administrator. ExpectedMemberRevision belongs to the source mutation; guard Sequence is read internally and rechecked with physical guard OCC. Preserve source preflight validation before recording withdrawal. AssignTeamMember restores only administrators_team_removed for this assignment; ReinstateMember restores only suspended. Built-in required role/perms cannot be removed. A completed source restoration with other ineligibility records TenantManagerRestorationCompleted without making the member available.
tests: unknown append and source authorization recovery
non-administrator suspension racing pending administrator registration for the same episode
non-administrator team removal never reads the guard
contracts.nonAdministratorBranch: First owner is route-determined, never state-determined: SuspendMember, DeprovisionMember and ReinstateMember always append a guard fact first (TenantManagerWithdrawalAccepted, TenantManagerRestorationAccepted or TenantManagerSourceMutationAdmitted when the member episode has no contribution and no pending transition). AssignTeamMember and RemoveTeamMember append a guard fact first exactly when team_id equals BuiltInRbac.AdministratorsTeamId; for every other team the TeamMember owner is first and the guard is never read. A pending registration or restoration for the same member episode is incompatible with a later withdrawal or neutral mutation: the later guard admission withdraws or fences it, so completion of that registration can never register availability for a suspended, deprovisioned or removed source.

expectedRevisionScope.meaning: authored source mutation precondition; not guard singleton sequence
